title: Handling Charge on Refunds of Reinstated Self-Pay Visit Packages
content:
**Refund controls — reinstated packages.** The reinstated-package handling charge applies to a Self-Pay Visit Package that has been reinstated: **$15.00** where no package visit has been used since the latest reinstatement, **$7.50** where one or more have, and none otherwise. The charge is subtracted from the refund.

**Reading the history**

- *Latest reinstatement:* the date of the latest visit credit for a reinstatement in the package history.
- *Package visit used since:* an attended appointment paid from the package whose appointment date is on or after that date.

| Package reinstated | Package visit used on or after the latest reinstatement | Handling charge |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | none | $15.00 |
| Yes | one or more | $7.50 |
| No | — | none |

**Dated cases (hypothetical: reinstated on 14 August)**

- Latest package visit used on 2 July: none since the reinstatement — $15.00.
- A package visit used on 14 August: used since — $7.50.
- A package visit used on 20 August: $7.50.
- A package never reinstated: no handling charge.
